PWD.description: Optional project or workspace root used by the PWD convention. Accepts absolute POSIX, drive-letter, UNC, and translated Windows device paths such as /repo, D:\work, D:/work, or //?/D:/work. Empty or non-directory values are treated as absent; when absent, every file path must already be absolute.

file.description: Use the exact file path to edit. Supports ${env:NAME} placeholders. When PWD resolves to an existing directory, relative file values are resolved from that root; otherwise file must already be absolute.

mode.description: Choose overwrite to replace or create a file, append for new-line file-end additions, replace_range for existing 1-based closed line ranges, or insert_before/insert_after for anchored inserts on existing lines.

content.description: Use the complete replacement or insertion text for the selected mode. Empty content is allowed only for overwrite or replace_range, where it clears the file or deletes the selected range.

start_line.description: Use only with replace_range; this is the first existing 1-based line to replace.

end_line.description: Use only with replace_range; this is the last existing 1-based line to replace.

line.description: Use only with insert_before or insert_after; this must point to an existing 1-based anchor line. Out-of-range values return line_out_of_bounds instead of appending.

files.description: Use for batch file edits. Provide up to 10 items, each with file, mode, content, and any mode-specific line arguments. Do not send this field together with root-level single-file edit arguments.

file.description: Use the exact file path to edit for this batch item. Supports ${env:NAME} placeholders. Relative paths require a valid root-level PWD.

mode.description: Choose overwrite, append, replace_range, insert_before, or insert_after for this batch item.

content.description: Use the complete replacement or insertion text for this batch item.

start_line.description: Use only with replace_range; this is the first existing 1-based line to replace for this batch item.

end_line.description: Use only with replace_range; this is the last existing 1-based line to replace for this batch item.

line.description: Use only with insert_before or insert_after; this must point to an existing 1-based anchor line for this batch item.

apply.description: Leave false for preview. Set true only when the previewed edit is ready to write. In batch mode this apply flag is shared by all files.
